Summary of 'The Evolution and Governance of Autonomous AI Systems':
The article discusses the transition of autonomous AI systems from simple conversational models into multi-agent architectures capable of orchestrating complex workflows. Key governance principles include runtime boundaries, least privilege, taint tracking, and cryptographic auditing to prevent unintended side-effects.
